data.title: Annual gas bill: €169.24 additional payment
data.summary: Beispielwerke Versorgung GmbH sent the annual gas bill for 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2026. After deducting your advance payments, you owe an additional €169.24, payable within 30 days of the invoice date (27 November 2026).
data.explanation: This is your yearly gas settlement (Jahresabrechnung). Your advance payments of €1,320.00 were lower than your actual consumption cost of €1,489.24, so you owe the difference of €169.24. Pay it by bank transfer within the 30-day period shown, quoting the invoice number. The letter says partial payments are possible by arrangement, so contact the supplier if you need that. Check the meter reading and consider whether your monthly advance should be adjusted.
